title: Cat in Pumpkin

steps.heading: Get ready
paragraphs: Cover your table. Follow the lines on your canvas. Leave the background white.
Use your small brush to paint the eye centers and the cat's mouth black. Leave a small white dot in each eye. Keep the tongue white. Let it dry.
steps.newPaint: Black eye centers and cat mouth

steps.heading: Paint the pumpkin
paragraphs: Use your large brush to paint the pumpkin and its top edge orange. Use a thin coat.
Leave the face holes, the opening behind the cat, and the cat white. Let the paint dry.
steps.alreadyPainted: Black eye centers and cat mouth
steps.remainWhite: Cat, ears, nose, tongue, eye rims, pumpkin openings, background

steps.heading: Paint the cat
paragraphs: Mix black with white and a tiny bit of blue to make gray. Paint the cat's head, paws and tail.
Leave the inside of the ears, nose, tongue and white parts of the eyes white. Let the paint dry.
steps.alreadyPainted: Orange pumpkin; black eye centers and mouth
steps.remainWhite: Inner ears, nose, tongue, eye rims, pumpkin openings, background

steps.heading: Add the little details
paragraphs: Pink: Mix white, a little red and a tiny bit of brown. Paint inside the ears, the nose and tongue.
Gold: Mix yellow with a little brown. Paint the curved eye edges.
Dark brown: Mix black with a little brown. Fill the pumpkin's face holes and opening behind the cat. Keep teeth orange.
Let it dry. With your small brush, follow the lines and whiskers in black. Add white eye dots.
steps.newPaint: Pink inner ears/nose/tongue; gold eye rims; dark pumpkin openings; black defining lines and whiskers; white eye dots
steps.alreadyPainted: Orange pumpkin; gray cat; black eye centers and mouth

care: Use thin coats. Rinse your brush and pat it dry when you change colors.
cleanup: Lay your canvas flat to dry. Wash your brushes and close the paint pots.
sourceNotes: Exact retained source images, no redraw; the existing square composition is placed at its historical registered rectangle, never stretched.
